decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis still has its own page in both years and is a value-added analytics service built on the firm's maintained market-data databases, which suits the platform strategy.

The regional electricity tariff calculator dropped from its own page to a mention, a sign it is being folded into the platform, but it stays close to the core tariff data offer and costs little to maintain.

The regional area definition tool lost its own page and likely now serves mainly as a supporting component for the location-based calculators, so it will probably be kept as an integrated function rather than withdrawn.
